prompt: Build a prompt for an interactive exhibition website for our archive, Loom Archive, with six tapestry pieces (piece-01.jpg to piece-06.jpg) that visitors can pan and zoom to explore in any direction.
output:
## Direction
**Model:** M6 Spatial canvas  
**Look:** Editorial Luxury  
**Stack:** Tier 1 standalone HTML/CSS/JS  
**Motion craft:** Weighted response, frameless media, spatial camera choreography  
**Why:** M6 lets visitors freely pan and zoom across six archive pieces while still providing an ordered keyboard tour. Editorial Luxury gives the tapestry images generous gallery space with a warm paper ground, dark text, and restrained red-brown highlights. Tier 1 keeps the archive portable as one standalone page.

## Scene plan
| # | Scroll | On screen | Motion | Still version |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0-15% | Overview with `piece-01.jpg` selected | Canvas eases from overview to piece 01 | Static overview with piece 01 first |
| 2 | 15-35% | `piece-02.jpg` centred | Pan and zoom smoothly toward piece 02 | Ordered piece 02 section |
| 3 | 35-55% | `piece-03.jpg` centred on an inverted field | Field and highlight colour shift; camera centres piece 03 | Ordered piece 03 section with contrast shift |
| 4 | 55-78% | `piece-04.jpg` centred | Camera pans and zooms to piece 04 | Ordered piece 04 section |
| 5 | 78-90% | `piece-05.jpg` centred | Camera settles into a tighter view of piece 05 | Ordered piece 05 section |
| 6 | 90-100% | `piece-06.jpg` centred, then overview | Camera centres piece 06 and returns to overview at the end | Ordered piece 06 section |

## Prompt
```text
GOAL: Build an interactive archive exhibition website for Loom Archive, for visitors who want to explore six tapestry pieces in any direction and remember the archive as a navigable collection. Use one standalone index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no libraries; a Google Fonts link is allowed.

CONTENT: Show the archive name "Loom Archive" and accessible item labels "piece-01.jpg", "piece-02.jpg", "piece-03.jpg", "piece-04.jpg", "piece-05.jpg", and "piece-06.jpg". Add no other words or facts.

SCENES: One 100svh spatial canvas with no scroll track. Ranges give keyboard and tour order.

Motif: Use the six provided tapestry images as the spatial media items. Arrange each image as one frameless rectangular artwork with its natural aspect ratio preserved, no invented frames, textures, labels, or decorative objects. Keep the six items separated at rest so every image is independently recognisable and selectable. Use a quiet overview composition containing all six images, then smoothly centre the active image during each tour stop.

Scene 1 | 0-15% | overview canvas, six images arranged in a spacious 3-by-2 composition inside the canvas, piece-01.jpg highlighted with a thin #7A2E2E outline, zoom 1, field #FAF8F4 | camera eases from overview to piece-01.jpg, zoom 1 -> 1.15 at 0-10%, then holds; highlight opacity 0.35 -> 1 at 0-10% | active item label "piece-01.jpg"
Scene 2 | 15-35% | piece-02.jpg centred at 50%/50% of the canvas, zoom 1.35, field #FAF8F4 | camera pans from piece-01.jpg to piece-02.jpg and zooms 1.15 -> 1.35 at 15-25%; selected outline moves from piece-01.jpg to piece-02.jpg at 15-20% | active item label "piece-02.jpg"
Scene 3 | 35-55% | piece-03.jpg centred at 50%/50% of the canvas, zoom 1.45, inverted field #171717 with #FAF8F4 text and image labels | camera pans from piece-02.jpg to piece-03.jpg and zooms 1.35 -> 1.45 at 35-45%; field and outline colours swap at 35-39% with no blank frame | active item label "piece-03.jpg"
Scene 4 | 55-78% | piece-04.jpg centred at 50%/50% of the canvas, zoom 1.35, field #FAF8F4 | camera pans from piece-03.jpg to piece-04.jpg and zooms 1.45 -> 1.35 at 55-67%; inverted field returns to #FAF8F4 at 55-59% | active item label "piece-04.jpg"
Scene 5 | 78-90% | piece-05.jpg centred at 50%/50% of the canvas, zoom 1.55, field #FAF8F4 | camera pans from piece-04.jpg to piece-05.jpg and zooms 1.35 -> 1.55 at 78-85%; selected outline moves to piece-05.jpg | active item label "piece-05.jpg"
Scene 6 | 90-100% | piece-06.jpg centred at 50%/50% of the canvas, zoom 1.35, then all six images return to overview, field #FAF8F4 | camera pans from piece-05.jpg to piece-06.jpg at 90-96%, holds at 96-98%, then returns to overview at 98-100%; selected outline moves to piece-06.jpg | active item label "piece-06.jpg"

MOTION: One 100svh pan-and-zoom canvas; camera (x, y, zoom) eases toward pointer pan/zoom or the active stop; Tab and arrow keys step through items in order and pan/zoom to centre each item; Esc or the final stop returns to overview.

Allow pointer drag, touch drag, mouse-wheel zoom, pinch zoom, and keyboard navigation. Keep native page scrolling available outside the canvas. Do not prevent native keyboard scrolling globally. Use transform-only image movement and opacity only for selection states. Keep interaction reversible and preserve the current camera state on resize.

LOOK: Ground #FAF8F4, text #171717, accent #7A2E2E for selection outlines and small controls only; inverted field #171717 with #FAF8F4 text and #C9A6A6 accent. Use Bodoni Moda for display text with Georgia, serif fallback and Instrument Sans for interface text with Arial, sans-serif fallback. Display text uses clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px), line height 1.05; interface text is at least 16px with line height 1.5 and a maximum measure of 60ch. Maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast. Never place readable text over an image.

LAYOUT: Use one full-screen 100svh spatial canvas with a quiet index/reset control inside 24px gutters. Keep the canvas and every image inside overflow-hidden containers; set overflow-x: clip on html, body, and the canvas wrapper. At 1440x900, place the canvas in a full-width media area and keep the archive name, active filename, instructions, and controls in a dedicated non-overlapping text-safe zone. At 390x844 and 360x640, keep the media canvas inside the top 0-76% of the viewport and the control/index region between 78% and 96%, with 24px gutters and no sideways scrolling. Images must remain fully selectable and must not overlap at rest. Do not use a fixed scroll track or closing lockup.

ASSETS: piece-01.jpg, piece-02.jpg, piece-03.jpg, piece-04.jpg, piece-05.jpg, piece-06.jpg. No stock, generated, or placeholder media.

FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order, every word visible at opacity 1, and the interactive canvas hidden until JavaScript activates it. Provide one compact static section for Loom Archive followed by six ordered sections, each containing its exact filename and corresponding image. When the active canvas class is set, hide the static fallback container so it never appears behind the canvas. Keep keyboard links and controls reachable with visible :focus-visible styles. Reduced motion disables camera easing and uses immediate pan/zoom changes while preserving all content and controls. No JavaScript shows the complete ordered archive. Failed images keep their filename visible and show a quiet role="status" message without a blank canvas. Deep links to item anchors select and centre the corresponding piece. Resize preserves the active item and clamps the camera to valid bounds.

AVOID: stacked template blocks while the interactive canvas is active, scroll progress bars, decorative loading bars, card grids, glowing borders, neon or purple-blue gradients, pill badges, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, invented captions, invented artwork metadata, logos, stock media, generated media, and text over images.

DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100% of the keyboard tour on 1440x900, 390x844, and 360x640, the correct piece is centred or the overview is shown, with no overlapping text, clipped artwork, empty screen, sideways scroll, or console error. Pointer pan, wheel zoom, pinch zoom, Tab, arrow keys, Esc, reset, deep links, resize, reduced motion, no JavaScript, and failed-image states all work. Report each check as passed, failed, or not run.
```
